title: Emitter state transition
statement: The transition rule on emitter states and Boolean inputs is as follows: from $n$, input $1$ leads to $n$ and input $0$ to $g$; from $g$, input $1$ leads to $k_1$ and input $0$ to $o$; from $k_1$, input $b$ leads to $k_2(b)$; from any $k_2(c)$, either input leads to $a$; from $a$, input $1$ leads to $u$ and input $0$ to $g$; from $u$, input $1$ leads to $u$ and input $0$ to $a$; and from $o$, either input leads to $o$.
